title: DairyGuard Kinetic: an open cold-chain spoilage monitor for milk
description: DairyGuard reads a cold-chain temperature log and estimates the shelf life used, the probability that milk has crossed the FSSAI bacterial limit, and the hours left at 4 °C. It includes a Python package and command line, C firmware for an ESP32, a browser app, ComBase-based growth-law studies, and a benchmark of 240,000 simulated deliveries that measures how much accuracy a temperature monitor loses to unobserved biology, sensor error, reading interval and decision rule. Full write-up: the book 'Beyond the 4 °C Alarm' (self-published, not peer reviewed).
